jobs.description:
Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at [mivo@cowi.com](

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

Are you an experienced commercial professional looking for an environment where your ideas matter, decisions move quickly, and your direct contribution makes a visible impact?

We built Trustpilot to be that place.

As AI reshapes how consumers search, discover, and choose brands, Trustpilot’s unique dataset of authentic human sentiment is becoming increasingly critical. We are uniquely positioned to define how trust and reputation function in an AI-driven digital economy and we’re building an inclusive environment where curious, ambitious people can do the best work of their careers.

We’re expanding our Enterprise business across the French market, and we’re looking for collaborative, forward-thinking professionals to help shape what’s next. You’ll work with some of the region’s leading brands at a moment when AI is fundamentally changing how reputation is built and how consumers make decisions, while helping businesses use authentic human sentiment to strengthen their visibility, credibility, and competitive position in the AI economy.

If you’re energised by building new approaches, solving complex challenges, and seeing the tangible impact of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

This role requires native-level French and strong professional English language skills. It is based in our Copenhagen office.

What you’ll be doing:

• Drive Portfolio Value: Manage a portfolio of Enterprise accounts across the French market, owning customer retention, guiding successful renewals, and identifying growth opportunities through thoughtful account mapping.

• Partner for Success: Work in close partnership with dedicated Customer Success Managers (CSMs). While you lead on commercial strategy, contract growth, and negotiations, your CSM partner guides adoption, implementation, and ongoing account health, delivering a seamless, high-value experience for our clients.

• Help Build the Playbook: Bring fresh perspectives to a growing function by sharing market insights, piloting retention and expansion initiatives, and co-creating our France Enterprise strategy.

• Demonstrate Value: Deeply understand client business goals and metrics to deliver measurable ROI, establishing Trustpilot as a trusted, long-term partner.

Who you are:

• Native-level French and strong professional English language skills

• Demonstrated track record managing Enterprise-level customer portfolios, with experience driving renewals, account retention, and commercial expansion within a SaaS or subscription-based environment.

• Comfortable navigating evolving environments, taking ownership of your outcomes, and eager to help shape an Enterprise approach rather than simply following a rigid process.

• Proven ability to co-manage complex customer relationships alongside Customer Success Managers, technical leads, and cross-functional teams.

• Skilled at leading thoughtful, consultative conversations with senior leadership and key stakeholders across diverse organizations.

• Excited to move beyond standard sales approaches and help tailor solutions that truly resonate within the European market.

What’s in it for you:

• Real ownership: influence how we grow within your market

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday with an additional 5 days after 12 months of continuous employment

• 2 (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Paid parental leave

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• An international workspace at our HQ in Copenhagen that’s complete with a coffee bar and canteen, with a wide variety of refreshments available. You can opt in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price.

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

_Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com)  quoting the role you wish to apply for._

*This role is based out of our Copenhagen HQ office and requires fluent French, with strong English skills*

As an Account Manager for the French Mid-Market, you’ll join our team at the heart of the action, right on our home turf in Copenhagen. You'll be literally at the centre of where the fun happens, with a unique opportunity to drive change and see the direct impact of your work on our business growth.You will join our French Mid-Market team, working closely with both Account Executives and Account Managers.

In this role, you will own customer retention and expansion. You will act as a Trusted Advisor, developing long-term relationships and strategic success plans that ensure customers derive maximum value from Trustpilot’s products. Your expertise will be key to driving retention, minimizing churn, and maximizing growth within this critical home market.

What you'll be doing:

• Take ownership of a customer portfolio for the French market, acting as the primary point of contact.

• Analyze market trends and customer behavior within France to identify opportunities for improvement and growth.

• Establish strong relationships with customers to ensure satisfaction, product adoption, and contract renewal.

• Develop and implement tailored strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and value delivery specifically for the French market.

• Ensure a premium experience by understanding client objectives and KPIs, and ensuring Trustpilot delivers against them.

• Increase renewal rates and reduce churn.

• Identify and successfully pursue upsell opportunities and new revenue streams.

• Act as a trusted advisor, advocating client needs to internal support, product, engineering, and sales teams.

• Successfully onboard clients and ensure they fully utilize their paid subscription.

Who you are:

• Native-level in French and proficient in English.

• 3+ years of Sales/Account Management/Customer Success experience, preferably in software industries, digital or online marketing.

• A genuine commitment to deeply understanding customer needs and exceeding expectations. You view customer success as a revenue driver.

• Proven track record in SaaS or Tech sales, with consistent quota achievement.

• Experience managing a portfolio of customer accounts with a focus on achieving a high renewal/retention rate.

• Proven experience in B2B sales or account management with subscription-based models.

• Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with multiple stakeholders.

• You thrive in a team-based environment and are excited by the opportunity to work regularly with colleagues in a Copenhagen-based setting.

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

Are you ready to shape the future of airport automation and collaborate with global team members to ensure seamless integration of complex systems? As a Senior Automation Engineer at BEUMER Group, you will take ownership of mission critical projects for baggage handling solutions in major airports worldwide. Leveraging your deep technical expertise, you ensure our systems keep millions of passengers moving safely and efficiently every day.

To further expand and strengthen our team in Airport Automation we are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to join our team. You will become part of the Project Engineering team, consisting of 12 highly skilled colleagues. The team is dedicated to working with our CrisBag system for some of the world's largest airports, which also means that if in your interest, traveling will be possible. Our systems operate around the clock and handle millions of bags annually, placing high demands in reliability, scalability and maintainability. Together with the team, you’ll bring tomorrow’s automation solutions to life with immediate access to our in-house test centre for prototyping, simulation, and validation.

Explore the CrisBag baggage handling system here.

Play a crucial part in developing cutting-edge technology for project delivery

As Senior Automation Engineer, we expect you to act as a technical authority, identifying opportunities for enhancement in existing systems and processes. You will work across the full automation stack including PLC, safety systems, network infrastructure, high-level system integration, commissioning and cross-disciplinary technical coordination. As an essential part of the role you will contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, development tools, simulation and emulation environments, testing methodologies, and software quality practices. You will participate in project definition and review meetings. Your tasks include but are not limited to:

• Developing PLC code for projects specific elements and solutions in our baggage handling system

• Defining the best solutions for specific projects

• Commissioning your PLC code in projects worldwide as well as testing your solutions virtually or at our test centre

• Reviewing layouts and solutions early in the process to secure the long-term success of our projects

• Mentor team members in code development, promoting best practices and knowledge-sharing

• Participating in the documentation of our solutions

Skilled Automation Engineer

We appreciate an inclusive mindset and the desire to be a part of a highly dedicated team, driven by the technology and world class products. We value curiosity, practical creativity, and engineers who think beyond code to create the best solutions. Moreover, we are looking for someone with the following qualifications:

• Advanced proficiency in Siemens TIA and SCL (Structured Control Language)

• Solid experience with modular software development, component-based architectures and structured PLC programming

• Speak and write English fluently

Furthermore, we expect that you possess strong coordination skills, in providing inputs for planning and resources. You thrive in a dynamic environment, and hold a proactive, detail-oriented mindset, enabling you to effectively manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams.

Culture at BEUMER

At BEUMER, we focus on creating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth. We encourage employees to explore new career paths and internal opportunities along the way. We value teamwork, and open collaboration. Our way of working is built on trust and respect for one another.

Maintaining a healthy work–life balance is a priority to us, which is why we offer flexible working options and up to two remote workdays per week. As a family-owned company, we also think long term, which means prioritizing stability, employee well-being, and strong, trust-based relationships. Further, we offer a wide range of social activities, such as padel tennis, fitness facilities, gaming, biking club and much more.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Head of Project Execution, Airport Engineering Poul Madsen on +45 5138 1904. We interview on an ongoing basis.

Join DynamicsPrint: A Leading Microsoft Preferred Solution for the Printing and Packaging Industry

DynamicsPrint has pioneered a Microsoft-preferred solution that is recognized as a preferred choice for the printing and packaging industry. Grounded in Microsoft 365 FO, our ISV solution covers every aspect, from quoting and production to resource planning and finance. Since our establishment in 1993, we have dedicated ourselves to the printing industry, accumulating invaluable insights and expertise. Fused with cutting-edge Microsoft technology, our knowledge positions us as trusted advisors and technology partners for the world’s leading printing companies.

ERP Consultant – Implementation

International Customers – Growing Industry – Strong Vertical Solution

We are seeking an experienced ERP Consultant with expertise in production planning to join our team. As a pivotal member of our company, you will be responsible for implementing and optimizing ERP systems, focusing specifically on production processes within the print and packaging industry.

In your role as an Implementation Consultant, you will report directly to the Consultant Manager and engage with our exciting customers in the print and packaging industry. Your primary responsibilities will include conducting GAP analysis, system specifications, manage on-site implementation, training super users, and coordinating with stakeholders. Your key responsibilities will involve:

• Conducting GAP analysis and pre-analysis on-site to understand the capabilities of both the standard solution and DynamicsPrint, identifying needs and potential gaps.

• Managing system implementation and onboarding.

• Facilitating user training and ensuring a smooth transition to the new systems for employees.

• Provide continuous support and make ongoing improvements to ERP solutions based on the company’s evolving needs.

• Collaborating with clients and stakeholders in the print and packaging sector to ensure that the solutions meet expectations and deliver tangible value.

• Coordinating with stakeholders (customers and partners).

• Learning and adapting quickly, with the expectation to independently manage projects after initial guidance in collaboration with internal and external project managers and developers.

What We’re Looking For:

Specialist, manager from the print industry or consultant with ERP experience.

You should have a strong background from the printing industry or ERP systems, excelling in functional expertise and communication, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and adapt in dynamic environments. An as individual, you’re characterized by your ability to manage diversity, work independently, and possess adaptability, teamwork, quick learning, and good communication skills. Experience with relevant print software or ERP software such as Microsoft, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar is preferred, especially with a focus on supply chain, production planning and optimization. Your experience may come from roles as pre-press, other specialist functions or middle management in the printing and packaging industry, or an internal or external ERP consultant. Ideally, you have a relevant education within graphical design/production, a degree in economics, IT, or a related field. We offer a competitive salary package and the opportunity to join a team of highly ambitious and talented individuals based in Farum, or in a hybrid/remote setup.

We offer:

• An exciting opportunity to work with leading companies and complex projects within the print and packaging industry.

• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative work culture.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• To be part of a customer centric growth journey.

Learn more about DynamicsPrint at the DynamicsPrint Website

What you'll do

You'll join a team of highly skilled engineers and consultants working at the intersection of IT, Operational Technology (OT), automation, and cybersecurity – with protecting and monitoring OT networks at the core of what we do.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Advanced threat detection and engineering: working extensively with industry-leading technology providers to deploy, test, and tune advanced threat monitoring solutions in production environments

• 
Technical implementation: leading the design and implementation of OT network segmentation projects, architecture redesign, secure remote access integration, and asset/configuration analysis

• 
Consultancy and advisory: acting as trusted advisor to clients and colleagues on architecture reviews and OT risk assessments, and translating technical risk into business impact

What you'll bring

We're looking for a seasoned OT Cybersecurity Principal Consultant with extensive experience in infrastructure solutions and technology deployment in OT environments.

The ideal candidate comes with:

• 
At least 5 years of experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, including client-facing consulting roles

• 
Demonstrated capability across critical security domains such as network segmentation, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, secure remote access, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and Security Operations Centre enablement

• 
A track record of continuous technical development — for example, certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC, CCNA/CCNP, or product certifications with recognised OT security vendors such as Nozomi or Claroty

On behalf of our client, Anticimex Innovation Center, Asgaard Recruitment is seeking a Senior Firmware Engineer to strengthen the firmware engineering team and contribute to the development, improvement, and industrialization of smart, connected products operating in demanding real-world environments.

Anticimex is a global leader in modern pest control and prevention. At Anticimex Innovation Center, ideas move from sketch to prototype to smart devices that transform pest control into a data-driven and more sustainable industry.

The role

As Senior Firmware Engineer, you will take a central role in developing and improving the firmware that brings connected devices to life, working closely with electronics, mechanics, and software/cloud teams to ensure that hardware and firmware perform reliably together.

The role combines hands-on firmware development with technical leadership. You will help set the professional standard for firmware design, support task coordination within the team, and contribute to stronger engineering practices across design reviews, release discipline, root-cause analysis, testing, documentation, and change management.

A key part of the role will be to help strengthen in-house firmware capabilities. Today, parts of the firmware development are handled by external partners, and Anticimex Innovation Center is now building stronger internal ownership of selected design, verification, and development activities.

You will work with embedded firmware for battery-powered IoT devices, low-power wireless connectivity, over-the-air updates, and production test support. The position is primarily based in Bagsværd. Some occasional travel to Helsinge expected to stay close to production, products, and technical problem-solving. Also, regular presence at the HQ of our strategic partner Sigma Connectivity in Lund, Sweden to be expected.

Your key responsibilities

You will:

• 
Develop and improve firmware for low-power, wireless IoT devices, from bring-up through production release

• 
Lead the structured transition of selected firmware development and verification activities from external partners to internal ownership, including tooling, documentation, and knowledge transfer

• 
Own firmware architecture in selected projects, including driver development, wireless connectivity stacks, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Contribute to verification and validation activities, including hardware/firmware bring-up, test planning, troubleshooting, certification readiness, and release processes

• 
Strengthen Stage-Gate execution, design review practices, documentation quality, engineering change processes, and controlled releases

• 
Collaborate closely with firmware architect, electronics, mechanics, software/cloud, production colleagues, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers

You will become a key technical voice in the firmware discipline, helping raise the engineering standard and ensuring that products are designed not only to work, but to work reliably at scale.

Who you are

You are an experienced firmware engineer with deep technical expertise and a strong interest in building connected products for the real world. You enjoy hands-on embedded development, structured problem-solving, and turning technical findings into robust, production-ready solutions.

You likely bring:

• 
7–10+ years of experience in embedded firmware development

• 
Strong experience with embedded C/C++ and real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or bare-metal development

• 
Experience with battery-powered IoT devices and low-power wireless connectivity (e.g. BLE, LoRaWAN, or cellular IoT)

• 
Experience with firmware architecture, driver development, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Experience with version control, automated testing, and CI/CD for embedded systems

• 
Experience working in structured product development models such as Stage-Gate

• 
Knowledge of security practices for connected devices (Ideally RED+CRA)

• 
Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you have experience with insourcing or transitioning development work from external partners, hardware bring-up and debugging (JTAG/SWD), cellular or LoRaWAN certification processes, PDM/PLM systems, ISO 9001, FMEA, or cloud/IoT platform integration.

Why Anticimex Innovation Center

Anticimex Innovation Center is at a pivotal moment. Moving from a fast-moving scale-up approach toward a more professional and scalable product-development organization, without losing agility.

Today, Anticimex has around 600,000 connected devices deployed globally, creating both strong proof of success and a need to further mature engineering practices, product robustness, and long-term ownership.

You will join an organization with strong ambitions, short decision paths, and real opportunities to influence how products are designed, improved, tested, documented, and industrialized. You will help raise the technical level of the firmware discipline and play an important part in building more scalable in-house development capabilities.

Is this you?

If you are motivated by embedded firmware development, low-power connected devices, technical problem-solving, and the opportunity to help shape the next generation of intelligent pest control solutions, we would like to hear from you.

We review applications continuously and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Company Description

Are you the one who brings structure when things get complex, and who walks over to ask why something has stalled rather than waiting for an email? Then you might be the Student Assistant we are looking for!

At JYSK, our Operational Centre of Excellence helps teams across IT and the business units it supports work in more stable and measurable ways. We are looking for a Student Assistant for 15 hours a week to work with data and stakeholder coordination at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus.

You start as soon as we have found the right candidate. For the first six weeks you work about one day a week, then 15 hours a week over two days, with at least one of them at the office. We start with a three-month contract and hope you stay at least 12 months. We are flexible around exams and holidays.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You work directly with the Manager of IT Operational Excellence and get real responsibility from day one. Within your first three months, you will have delivered your first piece of reporting that the IT leadership team uses.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Insight into how IT operations and continuous improvement work in an international retailer with more than 3,700 stores in 49 countries, more than 35,000 colleagues and an IT organisation of more than 400 people

• Room to shape your own role - this is a new area we are designing, and what you lean into will help define it

• A dedicated mentor, regular sparring and a network across IT that few students get

Technology & Transformation

In Deloitte Denmark, our Technology & Transformation teams work with the intersection of business and technology to help organizations navigate change and turn technology into practical, impactful solutions.

You will join a collaborative environment with ambitious colleagues, where learning, development, and teamwork are key – and where you get the opportunity to grow both professionally and personally.

• Work on case exercises and tackle real-life client challenges with peers

• Meet our consultants and hear their career stories first-hand

• Explore our tech teams and discover where your skills and interests fit in

Who are we looking for?

At Deloitte, we look for curiosity, drive, and passion for combining business and technology to create impact. A candidate who is:

A soon-to-be or recent graduate (up to 2 years of experience) within Computer Science, Engineering, IT or Business IT

• In possession of a valid Danish work and residence permit

• An interest in the balance and intersection between technology and business

• A problem solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges

• A passionate learner eager to grow your skills and career

• A team player who thrives in collaborative environments

• A candidate with a passion for collaborating with customers to solve their problems

Here you can read more about our offerings and what type of candidates they specifically are looking for:

AI & Data

In AI & Data, we help organizations solve their complex challenges by turning data into a strategic asset. This means you'll be hands-on with projects that span the entire data journey – from shaping AI strategy and building modern data platforms to developing and implementing agentic and generative AI, machine learning, analytics and automation solutions. You will collaborate with a team of advisors and deep-tech specialists to deliver tangible results for clients across all industries. We practice what we preach, applying AI-powered tools in our own work to enhance quality and accelerate delivery.

We are looking for curious and ambitious problem-solvers with a genuine interest in the connection between data, technology, and business. You don't need to be an expert yet, but an understanding of data engineering, data science, or AI concepts is essential, along with a strong desire to learn and grow.

ServiceNow

We combine consulting with hands-on implementation of ServiceNow solutions to help organizations streamline and future-proof their operations. Our work spans process automation, performance tracking, and digital workflow optimization across functions such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk and Compliance.

We are looking for curious and motivated candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You may lean more towards technical development or towards project and process work, but you should be interested in understanding how digital solutions support business outcomes.

You are not expected to have ServiceNow expertise before joining - competencies will be developed through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think abstractly and translate ideas into tangible solutions. For example, you should be able to interpret a written process description and visualize or structure it into a clear process flow.

Customer

At Deloitte Digital, we help organizations transform their front-office by designing and implementing CRM solutions across sales, marketing, and service. We are looking for talented colleagues who understand how technology supports customer-facing processes and are eager to work hands-on with CRM platforms.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of business and technology, can translate client requirements into practical solutions and is motivated to develop both functional expertise and technical skills in a dynamic, team-oriented environment.

Finance Transformation

In Finance Transformation, we help organizations modernize and improve the entire CFO area, from invoicing and reporting to finance strategy and financial planning. By combining business insight, technology, data, and process excellence, we help finance functions become more efficient and better equipped to support strategic decision-making.

As a junior consultant, you will gain exposure to a variety of projects across the CFO agenda and work closely with both colleagues and clients. This gives you the opportunity to build a broad understanding of finance transformation before gradually developing deeper expertise within a specific area that matches your interests and strengths.

We are looking for curious and analytical candidates with an interest in the intersection of business, finance, and technology. You enjoy solving complex problems, working with data, and collaborating with stakeholders to create practical solutions that deliver measurable impact.

Supply Chain & Network Operations

In Supply Chain & Network Operations (SCNO), we help organizations transform how they plan, optimize, and execute their supply chains. You'll work hands-on configuring platforms like Kinaxis Maestro and SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP), implementing decision intelligence solutions, and enabling resilient supply chains. You will collaborate with supply chain strategists, technical and industry experts to deliver transformational outcomes across complex, global supply networks.

You will translate supply chain requirements into technical solutions, work directly with client teams on implementation, and develop expertise in planning, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, and product lifecycle management. You'll gain exposure to digital thread designs connecting product design, manufacturing, and supply chain execution. You'll grow both technical skills in platform implementation and consulting skills in translating client challenges into designs.

We seek curious and ambitious candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You should be a collaborative team player who genuinely cares about client impact and learning from colleagues. You don't need platform expertise - competencies develop through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think systematically about interconnected processes, translate business requirements into technical specifications, and collaborate across teams.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.
